are_you_ok.title: Heavy rain drenches Colorado
are_you_ok.summary: Heavy rain soaked parts of Colorado over the weekend, leaving roads and trails muddy and prompting flood warnings in portions of the Denver metro area, the urban stretch southeast of Boulder.
questions: Did the rain cause any trouble where you are?
Are the trails around you washed out, or did Boulder mostly miss it?
